prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1399; do not mention it.)
text: This office has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Within fourteen days of receipt of this letter, please provide written confirmation of the bodily injury and property damage liability limits applicable to the policy, along with a copy of the declarations page. We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including the insured's and claimant's vehicle data, photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file materials, repair estimates, and any dash camera or telematics records. Any destruction, alteration, or loss of such materials following receipt of this notice may give rise to claims for spoliation. We look forward to your prompt response.
